title: Signal: npm client installs with a floating range by default
scope: A .npmrc file that declares a client setting that writes a caret range when a dependency is added.
limitations: It matches a client setting that writes a caret range when a dependency is added in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .npmrc that mentions a client setting that writes a caret range when a dependency is added in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
